behavior.arguments: rdx = first base struct, rcx = first index; rdi = second base struct, rsi = second index. For each (struct, index) pair: index <= 0x1f (unsigned) -> pointer = [struct+0x108] + index*8; index > 0x1f -> pointer = [struct+0x110] + (index-0x20)*8. The qwords at the two computed pointers are then swapped.

branch_targets.high_second_ja: ja at offset 0x4f (2 bytes, disp 0xca = -54) lands on the high-second block at offset 0x1b (0x4fa90bb).
branch_targets.low_first_jbe: jbe at offset 0x04 (2 bytes, disp 0x3a) lands on the low-first block at offset 0x40 (0x4fa90e0).
branch_targets.low_second_jbe: jbe at offset 0x19 (2 bytes, disp 0x36) lands on the low-second block at offset 0x51 (0x4fa90f1).

edges.both_high: first index 0x25 -> high base + 0x28; second index 0x20 -> high base + 0.
edges.both_low: first index 3 -> low base + 0x18; second index 5 -> low base + 0x28; values at those pointers exchange.
edges.high_boundary: index 0x20 takes the high base with offset 0; index 0x1f takes the low base with offset 0xf8.
edges.low_boundary: index 0x1f takes the low base; index 0x20 takes the high base.
edges.wrapping: pointer arithmetic wraps at 64 bits on both low and high paths.

behavior.entry_shape: Opens with cmp $0x1f,%rcx (no endbr64); three conditional branches (jbe, jbe, ja), no loop, no calls; two identical swap blocks; 9-byte nopw between the swap blocks.
behavior.return_rule: No return value claimed: on exit rax holds the first computed pointer and rdx the second, with rcx/rsi holding the swapped values. The only writes are the two swapped qwords.

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, without a guessed loader or Ghidra rebase. The ELF section table maps .text with file offset = VA - 0x1000; the retained .eh_frame has equal file offset and VA. The tools resolve sections rather than assuming one global VA/file-offset relationship.

incoming_pattern_scan.note: Byte-pattern scan over the full .text section (70,370,352 bytes) for e8 sites whose rel32 lands on the window start; four sites found, all in the single caller FDE [0x4fabb90, 0x4fac29f). This is explicitly not a complete xref census: indirect calls, tail jumps, and PLT references are out of scope for the scan.
incoming_pattern_scan.relocation_note: No relocation record of any type in any .rela.* section names this window as addend (full-section scan: 80,022 .rela.dyn + 278 .rela.plt entries).
